core: DNA double-strand break signalling and repair pathway choice
qualifier: break-site chromatin remodelling and ADP-ribosylation regulating NHEJ versus HR
name: Break-site chromatin signalling regulating NHEJ versus homologous recombination
rationale: All members concern sensing and signalling at double-strand breaks and the positive/negative regulation of NHEJ and HR; unlike the confusables (broad HR/BRCA defect and resection sets) it carries break-site chromatin remodelling, ADP-ribosylation and protein recruitment to breaks.

qualifier: CD28-Vav1 and raft signalling complex assembly
name: Immunological synapse signal complex assembly in T cells
rationale: Members cover T cell synapse formation, polarity, raft localization, CD28-Vav1 and CORO1A-DEF6 signalling complexes and second-messenger generation, whereas confusables emphasise integrin-mediated adhesion, homing and leukocyte migration.

core: Striated muscle sarcomere assembly and contraction
qualifier: cardiomyocyte intercalated-disc desmosomal junctions
name: Striated muscle sarcomere and cardiomyocyte intercalated-disc junctions
rationale: Members span myofibril/filament assembly, contraction, T-tubules and cardiomyocyte cell-cell adhesion via desmosomes and intermediate filaments; the junctional component distinguishes it from confusables centred on muscle development, costameres or SRF targets.

qualifier: spindle assembly checkpoint
name: Mitotic spindle formation and spindle assembly checkpoint
rationale: All members concern mitotic spindle assembly, PLK1-driven mitosis and MAD2 checkpoint control, distinguishing it from meiotic, G2/M kinase activation, chromosome condensation/cohesion and spindle midzone confusables.

qualifier: Th17 lineage commitment
name: Th17 cell interleukin-17 production and signalling
rationale: Every member is IL-17 production, IL-17/IL-17A receptor signalling or Th17 commitment, separating it from Dectin/antifungal, IL-1 processing, Th1 and IL-33/36/38 confusables.

qualifier: protein kinase A activation
name: GPCR–adenylyl cyclase cAMP production and PKA activation
rationale: Members describe cyclic-nucleotide-coupled GPCR signalling, cAMP synthesis (including forskolin response) and PKA activation, unlike confusables centred on adenylyl cyclase inhibition (alpha-2, Gz) or CREB downstream output.

qualifier: presynaptic dopamine synthesis, secretion and catecholamine reuptake
name: Presynaptic dopamine synthesis, secretion and catecholamine reuptake
rationale: Members cover dopamine biosynthesis, release, catecholamine/monoamine transport and uptake and dopaminergic transmission, distinct from confusables on SLC6A3 disease, norepinephrine uptake and postsynaptic dopamine receptor signalling.

qualifier: di- and tricarboxylates and the malate-aspartate shuttle
name: Di- and tricarboxylate transport and malate–aspartate shuttle
rationale: All members are SLC-mediated organic anion transport of succinate, citrate-type carboxylates, sialic acid or shuttle metabolites; confusables instead carry pyruvate/alpha-ketoglutarate, cationic amino acid or glutamate metabolism.

qualifier: vestibular balance sensing and hair cell specification
name: Vestibular balance sensing and inner ear hair cell specification
rationale: Members concern equilibrioception, gravity response, otoliths, vestibular reflex and hair cell fate/outer hair cell control, while confusables are cochlear auditory transduction or ear and craniofacial morphogenesis.

qualifier: BAX/BAK permeabilization through apoptosome and SMAC-IAP caspase activation
name: BAX/BAK outer membrane permeabilization to apoptosome caspase activation
rationale: Members run from BAX/BAK oligomerisation and MOMP regulation through cytochrome c release to apoptosome and SMAC/IAP control of caspases, whereas confusables centre on upstream BH3-only protein activation.

qualifier: UV-A and blue light response and melanocyte proliferation
name: Light-induced melanocyte proliferation and melanin pigmentation
rationale: Members cover melanin biosynthesis, MITF pigmentation genes, pigment granule localization and melanocyte responses to UV-A and blue light; the light-response and proliferation members separate it from melanosome biogenesis, organelle acidification and broader MITF-program confusables.

qualifier: IL-3, IL-5, IL-7 and IL-9
name: IL-3, IL-5, IL-7 and IL-9 hematopoietic cytokine signalling
rationale: All members are class I cytokine receptor signalling (IL-2/3/5/7/9, G-CSF shutoff); the IL-3/IL-5/IL-9 and G-CSF members separate it from confusables focused on IL-2-STAT5 T cell, FLT3-STAT5 or IL-15/IL-21 NK signalling.

qualifier: lymphoid organ homing and development
name: Chemokine-guided leukocyte homing and lymphoid tissue development
rationale: Members are chemokine/CXCR4/CCR7/S1P-driven chemotaxis of lymphocytes, dendritic cells and other leukocytes plus lymph node, MALT and B cell development, unlike confusables centred on integrin adhesion or CCR2/CX3CR1 monocyte recruitment.

qualifier: calcium channel and G-beta-gamma/GIRK modulation of excitability
name: Presynaptic calcium channel and Gβγ–GIRK control of excitability
rationale: Members concern presynaptic depolarization, calcium channel opening and its G-beta-gamma inhibition, GIRK activation, kainate and extrasynaptic GABA effects on release; confusables instead hold mGluR-mediated suppression, inhibitory synapse assembly or nicotinic receptors.

qualifier: carnitine, choline and FMO trimethylamine oxidation
name: Carnitine, choline and trimethylamine metabolism
rationale: All members concern carnitine synthesis/transport, choline catabolism or FMO3 oxidation of trimethylamine, distinguishing it from transsulfuration, SAM/methionine and creatine/phospholipid confusables.

qualifier: cAMP-coupled control of feeding behaviour and pituitary secretion
name: Peptide hormone GPCR cAMP signalling and feeding behaviour regulation
rationale: Members combine calcitonin/amylin/CGRP, glucagon, relaxin, somatostatin and ghrelin receptor signalling via cAMP with appetite and GH/prolactin secretion; confusables lack these GPCRs and carry leptin, GH JAK-STAT or nutrient lipid receptors.

qualifier: adenine nucleotide, phosphocreatine and NAD(P)
name: Adenine nucleotide, phosphocreatine and NAD(P) energy carrier metabolism
rationale: Members cover nucleotide di/triphosphate interconversion, mitochondrial ADP/ATP transport, creatine/phosphocreatine and NAD(P) synthesis, salvage and transport, whereas confusables are viral apoptosis or nucleoside transport and purine catabolism.

qualifier: sodium-calcium exchanger clearance
name: Cytosolic calcium handling with sodium–calcium exchanger clearance
rationale: Members address cytosolic calcium responses, sequestration and reduction via Na+/Ca2+ exchangers, unlike confusables centred on ER/ryanodine calcium release and store-operated entry.

qualifier: oxidative and hypoxic stress-induced intrinsic apoptosis
name: Mitochondrial respiration control and oxidative/hypoxic stress-induced apoptosis
rationale: Members regulate oxidative phosphorylation, electron transport, ATP synthesis and ROS together with peroxide/hypoxia-triggered intrinsic apoptosis; the respiration and PGC-1alpha arm separates it from ferroptosis/nitrosative stress and calcium-flux confusables.

qualifier: isocitrate-NADPH and succinate-linked respiration
name: TCA cycle intermediates, isocitrate–NADPH and succinate-linked respiration
rationale: Members are TCA cycle and intermediate metabolism (isocitrate, 2-oxoglutarate, succinate, malate) with NADPH regeneration and succinate-to-ubiquinone electron transport; confusables instead carry PDH/OGDH complexes, CoA synthesis or the malate-aspartate shuttle.

qualifier: nucleotide-sugar supply and lysosomal glycan degradation
name: Glycoconjugate glycosylation, nucleotide-sugar supply and lysosomal glycan degradation
rationale: Members span N-/O-glycan, GPI and glycosphingolipid synthesis, nucleotide sugar/sialic acid supply and transport and lysosomal glycan catabolism; confusables are restricted to dolichol/early CDG steps or proteoglycan and O-mannosyl glycosylation.

qualifier: cholinergic nicotinic/muscarinic and serotonergic
name: Cholinergic and serotonergic receptor neurotransmission
rationale: All members are acetylcholine (nicotinic, muscarinic, release, metabolism) or serotonin receptor signalling, separating the theme from histamine, adenosine/PDE and tachykinin confusables.

qualifier: collagen and extracellular matrix production
name: Osteoprogenitor proliferation, differentiation and collagen matrix production
rationale: Members regulate mesenchymal stem cell and osteoblast proliferation/differentiation with collagen, proteoglycan and matrix secretion, trabecular bone and tendon; confusables emphasise RUNX2/BMP control, mineralization and ossification modes.

qualifier: extracellular ATP release and hydrolysis with calcium elevation
name: Extracellular ATP/adenosine purinergic signalling and calcium elevation
rationale: Members cover ATP export, NTPDase hydrolysis, P2Y and adenosine receptor signalling and resulting cytosolic calcium rise, unlike confusables on lipid/histamine/prostanoid GPCRs or KATP channels.

qualifier: regulation of alternative splicing
name: snRNP biogenesis and regulation of alternative splicing
rationale: Members cover snRNA cap hypermethylation, transport and snRNP assembly plus positive/negative splicing regulation, distinct from snRNA transcription, histone mRNA 3' processing and core spliceosome catalytic-step confusables.
